_source: OpenStreetMap contributors (via Overpass); UT Austin building register. Not affiliated with UT Austin.
_format: n.x/n.y: quantised by q, first absolute then deltas. e.a: delta from the previous edge's a. e.b: offset from this edge's a. e.w: centimetres. e.f: flag byte 1 steps, 2 crossing, 4 signalled, 8 incline-up-a-to-b, 16 bridge, 32 covered, 64 wheelchair=yes (informational ONLY, never route on it), 128 off-main-component. e.s: steps way id or -1, so a router counts STAIRCASES and never steps. d: [x,y,anchorNodes,linkCm,role,src,ref,name]. poi: [x,y,node,cat,name,opening_hours].
